BL-1818 — The pipeline board's grid cell shows how long the seat has held each active ticket (0m, 45m, 12h, 3d from the stage map's as-of) instead of a fixed X, in 3-character cells that absorb the separator so the header and the 30-character phone budget hold - and a ruling on how a dwell-only change refreshes the board
What it solves: ## Human, verbatim (Article 5.3)
Approval context: One choice: how the Telegram board refreshes when only a dwell value changed (no stage moved). Today any content change deletes the board message and posts a fresh one (BL-462), checked on a ~30 s tick, so dwell minutes counted as content would repost about once a minute. FIRM, not asked: the cell …
